summary.headline: Chapters on Illness and Astrology
summary.text: Catalog of chapters 72–90 on runaways, imprisonment, letters, divination, lawsuits, bloodletting, purgatives, illness, surgery, hidden things, attacking enemies, turning, and planetary years, with folio references to Florentine and Viennese codices. Entries cite astrological indications involving the Moon, Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, the Sun, and signs including Aries, Pisces, Virgo, and Gemini.
